$comment: Gzip budget of the web app's first load, checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs after the web build (CI: Web build). Measured 2026-10-26: entry 296 KB, entry and its static imports 663 KB. Raised to 695 KB on 2026-10-30 for replan-the-day (the missed-block count and packer that Day, Week and Today need before the lazy preview). Raised to 700 KB (entry 313 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-frames: the frame occurrences, the bands behind the Day and Week blocks and the Plan-from-a-frame placement are drawn with the grid (about 3 KB); the Frames dialog is lazy, and lazy bands cost more in shared-chunk overhead than they saved. Raised to 705 KB on 2026-10-30 for calendar-slots (measured 702.8 KB): the slot block with its checklist and details, the slot rows of the phone agenda, the slot start in every list row's time column (TaskRow) and the Schedule sheet's slot choices are drawn on first load (about 4 KB, as design D11 estimated); a lazy details popover measured the same 702.8 KB, so it stays static. Entry raised to 314 KB on 2026-10-30 for bento-daily-check (measured entry 313.1 KB, first load 703.7 KB): the Bento read (sizes, the reconciled slots and the Frog or Summit order) is needed by the Focus engine in the shell, the Loop home and the Daily focus rows of How you work; changing a Bento, the slot rows and the slot menu load with the review screens. Raised to 707 KB on 2026-10-30 for task-energy (measured first load 705.5 KB, entry 313.5 KB): the energy read and its word on every row (TaskRow), the ~deep token in the quick-add parser and its suggestions, the energy filter terms in the parser and evaluator, and the Energy fact, submenu and choice are needed where tasks are drawn and typed (about 1.8 KB, under the 2 KB design estimate); none of it is a screen of its own to load lazily. Raise only on purpose, with the reason in the pull request. Raised to 713 KB (entry 320 KB) on 2026-10-30 for calendar-clarity (measured first load 711.1 KB, entry 318.3 KB): deadline markers on Day, Week, Month and Plan, adding with the pointer (double-click, the add menu, the long press), Colour by for the calendar and boards, the calendar's and Upcoming's query filter with its chip, and the project Calendar layout are drawn with the views (about 5.6 KB against the 3 KB design estimate); the filter dialog is lazy, and a lazy project Calendar layout split ProjectHeader and the views into a shared chunk that measured 8 KB more. Raised to 715 KB (entry 321 KB) on 2026-10-30 for view-manual-order (measured first load 714.1 KB, entry 320.1 KB): the order read of label pages and saved views (lib/viewOrder) and their drag and Alt+arrow handling are drawn with those lists (TaskListView, SavedViewView, about 1.1 KB); the write and its Undo load with the first move. Raised to 716 KB on 2026-10-31 for phone-touch-focus (measured first load 715.4 KB, entry 319.6 KB): the Add to focus / Put in a slot / Remove from focus item of the task menus (the Actions menu, the task panel and page, the Focus screen) needs the focus state where those menus are drawn, and the picker host lives in the shell (about 1.3 KB with the Bento read, which moved out of the entry into the shared chunk); the rules, the writes and the picker load lazily with the first use. Raised to 717 KB on 2026-10-31 for notes-compaction (measured first load 716.4 KB, entry 320.4 KB): the Database storage card is lazy, but its settings copy and search entry (settingsCopy, settingsIndex, read by the settings search in the shell) and the History line that older note versions are kept one per day (task tab and project panel) are drawn on first load (about 0.4 KB). Raised to 718 KB on 2026-10-31 for notes-toolbar-desktop (measured first load 717.5 KB, entry 320.6 KB): the comment composer is part of the task page, which the shell loads statically, and its Formatting toggle now remembers its row on the device and reads the synced Formatting button setting; the toggle and its device state are one small chunk shared with the lazy note editor (0.9 KB with its imports), and the setting row and its search entry add about 0.2 KB. The roving-focus toolbar stays in the lazy editor chunk.
